verdict.rationale:
Crossplane's control-plane model is inherently autonomous background automation: declared resources are continuously reconciled and drift is auto-corrected without human intervention, and docs explicitly frame its declarative APIs as things 'automation and AI systems can safely act on'. However, evidence doesn't show a specific AI-agent workflow or independent confirmation of AI-driven autonomous setup — it's inferred from general control-loop/reconciliation behavior rather than an AI-specific feature.
Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent tooling/integration story, independent/hands-on evidence of an AI system actually configuring and running autonomous Crossplane automations.
